reference: She usually stays dry, but today she is dancing in the rain.
sk: Zvyčajne ostáva pod strechou, ale dnes tancuje v daždi.
cz: Obvykle zůstává pod střechou, ale dnes tančí v dešti.
acceptable: {She usually|Usually she|She normally} {stays dry|stays inside|stays indoors|stays under cover}, but today she is dancing in the rain.
{She usually|Usually she|She normally} {stays dry|stays inside|stays indoors|stays under cover}, but she is dancing in the rain today.

mistakes.text: She usually {stays dry|stays inside}, but today she dances in the rain.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dnes sa to deje teraz, patrí tu Present Continuous: „is dancing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Dnes se to děje teď, patří sem Present Continuous: „is dancing“.

mistakes.text: She usually is staying {dry|inside}, but today she is dancing in the rain.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre zvyk patrí Present Simple: „usually stays“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro zvyk patří Present Simple: „usually stays“.

mistakes.text: She usually stay {dry|inside}, but today she is dancing in the rain.
She usually {stays dry|stays inside}, but today she is dancing in rain.
She usually {stays dry|stays inside}, but today she is dancing {on|at} the rain.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'ostáva/zůstává pod strechou' (stays under a roof), EN 'stays dry'; indoor/under-cover wordings accepted.
